manifest.name: Last.fm Local Top Tracks
manifest.description: Artist top tracks for your local library, ranked by Last.fm's global popularity. No streaming service required.

api_key.label: Last.fm API key
api_key.description: A Last.fm API key with read access. Leave empty on an official Music Assistant build to use its built-in key. Create a key at https://www.last.fm/api/account/create. No shared secret is used.

chart_refresh_days.label: Chart refresh (days)
chart_refresh_days.description: Days to keep using a saved Last.fm chart before asking again. 42 days is 6 weeks. If Last.fm is unreachable, the last saved chart is still used.

clear_charts.label: Clear saved charts
clear_charts.description: Delete every saved Last.fm chart for this provider. The next artist page asks Last.fm again. Library tracks stay.
